summary.text: Joseph Depasquale is an independent candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 67, where he faces Democrat Nicole Jellinek in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously ran as an independent in 2010 and lost to incumbent Democrat Jan Malik in the general election for Rhode Island House District 68.
